headline: Revenue growth sustains; margin recovery expected

highlights: Per (%) -23/-26/-37 12M Avg Val (INR M) 286 Free float (%) 57.6 Financials & Valuations (INR b) Y/E MARCH FY26 FY27E FY28E Sales 18.6 21.1 24.4 EBITDA -2.4 -0.7 2.5 Adj.
Revenue growth was primarily driven by new product launches, while gross margins expanded despite raw material inflation led by premiumization.
However, profitability remained under pressure, with the company reporting an EBITDA loss of INR331m.
The ongoing transformation under the new management team is beginning to reflect in the revenue trajectory, supported by new product launches, premiumization, and brand-building initiatives.
